name: Home-Style Slow-Roasted Pot Roast with Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Melt-in-your-mouth slow braised beef chuck roast served in savory brown beef gravy over smooth mashed potatoes. It provides rich complete protein and low-fiber starch with zero fried crust.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for extra smooth mashed potatoes and tender roast meat. Skip whole glazed baby carrots or whole green beans if currently adhering to a strict low-residue diet.
